card.text: Explore Phobos in 3D with cssEarth. Inspect mapped spacecraft imagery, elevation and the measured irregular shape of Mars’s moon.

introduction.text: Phobos is the larger, inner moon of Mars. Its irregular surface is crossed by grooves and dominated by Stickney crater. It completes an orbit in less than eight hours.

normal.title: Controlled multi-mission mosaic
normal.summary: Images from several missions are registered to the same surface. Detail varies; photographed shadows and edited seams remain.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to an 11.1 km sphere, from the 2023 model. Shading shows slopes; mesh spacing is about 148 m.

albedo.title: SPC relative albedo model
albedo.summary: Relative brightness solved jointly with shape from mission images; this is the released SPC scale, not a natural-color photograph or a calibrated absolute albedo.

slope.title: Modeled surface slopes
slope.summary: Slope relative to modeled gravity, using uniform density, rotation and Mars at the mean orbital distance. Values come from the released facet table.
